businessGoal: Enable visitors to send inquiries and receive support through a contact form.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the contact form is displayed when navigating to the contact page.
Check that required fields (first name, last name, email, subject, message) are shown in the contact form.
Verify that the subject dropdown includes the specified options.
Ensure that a validation error is shown when the message has fewer than 50 characters.
Confirm that a confirmation message is displayed and the form is hidden upon successful submission with valid data.

manual.reason: The story includes user interface components and interactions that require manual testing.

api.reason: The story does not mention any API behavior or capability for validating behaviors via API.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria describe visible browser behaviors and user interactions.
